_meta.source: U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom annual reports 2001-2026 (https://www.uscirf.gov/annual-reports); U.S. Department of State IRFA determinations published in the Federal Register (govinfo.gov)
_meta.licence: US federal government works: public domain in the US (17 U.S.C. 105)
_meta.citation: USCIRF, Annual Report (years as listed); U.S. Department of State, Secretary of State's Determination Under the International Religious Freedom Act of 1998, Federal Register (dates as listed).
notes: USCIRF lists are recommendations by an advisory commission; State Dept lists are the legal designations.

Category names changed: CPC recommendations were called Tier 1 (2013-2019); Tier 2 (2013-2019) and Watch List (2003-2012) are USCIRF categories preceding its Special Watch List recommendations (2020-). The statutory State Dept Special Watch List exists from 2018 (Frank R. Wolf Act, 2016).
year for USCIRF records = report year (report covers the previous calendar year). year for State records = year of designation.
The 2000 annual report has no country list. 2001 and 2002 records come from recommendation letters described in those reports.
Entities of Particular Concern (non-state actors) are not included.
